'''Bakmar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He sold his wares in the [[Republic Concourse]] of the [[Mercantile Plaza]]. While working he wore the [[Color/Legends|blue]] and white [[Robe/Legends|robes]] of an adherent of the [[Order of Shasa]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] organization based on Manaan. Orloth's [[Hair/Legends|hairless]] skin was brown in color and his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were orange. When speaking to customers he spoke in a language other than [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bakmar was created as a character for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], although he was not added to the game until update 2.9 in [[2014]]. The update added the planet Manaan as a location to the game as a setting for the new "Depths of Manaan" flashpoint, which Bakmar served as the Republic flashpoint vendor for, with [[Orloth]] as his counterpart for Sith Empire players. He accepts only Manaan research data as payment for his inventory, a currency earned only by playing through the flashpoint.
